newsitem.title: SAN MARINO: SOCCER-GROUP LEADERS THE NETHERLANDS ROUT SAN MARINO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GROUP LEADERS THE NETHERLANDS ROUT SAN MARINO.

text.p: Former European champions The Netherlands routed San Marino 6-0 on Wednesday in a World Cup qualifier to maintain their lead in group seven.
The Dutch have 15 points from six matches, followed by Belgium, 3-1 winners over Turkey, who have 12 and a game in hand.
A poor first half did not produce a goal until the 40th minute, Dennis Bergkamp scoring. He netted a second in the dying seconds of the match.
Aron Winter, Pierre van Hooijdonk, Frank de Boer and John Bosman, who made his return in the Dutch team after a two-and-a-half year absence, were the other marksmen in the second half.
